name: DeepLoop
tagline: Stabilize shared depth through normalization and scaling.
description: Twelve shared blocks execute twice with DeepLoop α/β scaling. Because sharing, residual parameterization and normalization change together, paired controls are needed to distinguish their effects.
mechanism: 12 shared blocks × 2 recursions, with no separate prelude or coda
Inner and outer RMSNorm with residual scaling α = √(2N)
Initialization gain β = 1/√(8N) for V/O and both feed-forward matrices
limitations: Scaling the native Value Embeddings is an adaptation. Normalization controls should be reported separately.
